observation: Final render frame appears essentially black/empty; no visible smoke density or flame emission from the Mantaflow explosion setup.
expected_behavior: A small fiery explosion should show a bright emissive fireball core with surrounding smoke volume at the chosen frame (e.g., frame ~12).
actual_behavior: No discernible volume, flame, glow, or silhouette; image reads as a blank/black frame.
recommended_fix: 1) Debug visibility first: set film_transparent=False and raise exposure by +4 stops (temporarily) to confirm the volume exists. 2) Increase flow density to 5.0 and temperature to 8.0 for a stronger impulse. 3) Increase emissive output: multiply Flame->Emission Strength by ~8x (e.g., 25 -> 200) or set emission_strength to ~80-120. 4) Verify cache frames 1-30 contain density/flame/temperature at frame 12.
analysis_notes: Render emptiness can be caused by either no sim data (inflow not emitting / cache empty / wrong frame range) or data present but underexposed and/or emissive too weak, especially with transparent film over a black background.
